title: A Study of BMS-986548 as Monotherapy and in Combination With Anti-cancer Agents in Participants With Advanced Solid Malignancies
official: A Phase 1/2a, Open-Label, Multicenter Study to Assess the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Preliminary Efficacy of BMS-986548 as Monotherapy and in Combination With Anti-Cancer Agents in Participants With Advanced Solid Malignancies
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the safety, tolerability, efficacy, and drug levels of BMS-986548 as a monotherapy and in combination with anti-cancer agents in participants with advanced solid malignancies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Participants must have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of a locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic solid tumor malignancy with a known Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog (KRAS) alteration (mutation or amplification).
* Participants must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 or 1.
* Participants must have measurable disease assessed by the investigator using Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.
* Participants should have previously received, be ineligible for, or decline (after having been provided adequate information to make an informed decision) the following Standard of Care (SoC) treatments:.

  i) Part 1A: All appropriate SoC treatments for the disease under study

ii) Part 2A:,

A. Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC): platinum-based doublet chemotherapy and/or PD-(L)1 checkpoint inhibitor.

B. Colorectal Cancer (CRC): fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and/or irinotecan-based chemotherapy, and Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF)-targeted antibodies. For participants with dMMR/Microsatellite Instability-High (MSI-H) (or POLE/POLD1 mutation) CRC, a checkpoint inhibitor (PD-\[L\]1 and/or CTLA-4).

C. Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC): fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy with oxaliplatin and irinotecan (may include liposomal formulation) and/or gemcitabine-based chemotherapy with albumin-bound paclitaxel or cisplatin.

iii) Part 1B, Part 2B:,

A. CRC: fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and/or irinotecan-based chemotherapy, and VEGF-targeted antibodies. For participants with dMMR/MSI-H (or POLE/POLD1 mutation) CRC, a checkpoint inhibitor (PD-\[L\]1 and/or CTLA-4).

Exclusion Criteria

* Participants must not have had prior treatment with a (K)RAS directed therapy including approved treatments and investigational agents.
* Participants must not have untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases.
* Participants must not have concurrent malignancy (present during screening) requiring treatment or history of prior malignancy active within 2 years prior to treatment.
* Participants must not have a history of (non-infectious) Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)/pneumonitis requiring steroids, current ILD/pneumonitis, or where suspected ILD/pneumonitis cannot be ruled out by imaging at screening.
* Participants must not have a history of prior Severe Cutaneous Adverse Reactions (SCARs), including Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS) and Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN).
* Other protocol-defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria apply.
